usageNotes: Use this to discover all configured notification endpoint types available in the cluster (e.g. gotify, sendmail, smtp, webhook). No parameters are required and no special privilege is needed beyond a valid API token. This is typically the first call when building a notification workflow — use the returned name values as child identifiers to drill into specific endpoint configurations.

examples.summary: List all notification endpoint types on the cluster

tips: The response is an index of endpoint type categories (e.g. 'gotify', 'sendmail', 'smtp', 'webhook') — not individual configured endpoints; follow child links (the 'name' field) to enumerate instances.
Accessible by all authenticated users, including unprivileged API tokens, making it safe to use in read-only automation.
